title: How late can a shipper change reefer settings before the vessel departs?
content:
## Scope

This time rule of **Reefer Cargo Services** sets the latest moment at which a change to the carrying settings is accepted **before departure**. It applies to every tier.

## Rule

1. A change before departure is accepted only when it is received no later than the tier's cutoff hours before the scheduled departure date.
2. The cutoff is midnight at the **start** of the ETD date, in the local time of the port of loading, less the tier's cutoff hours, counted as full 60-minute hours.
3. A change received **exactly at** the cutoff is accepted.
4. The ETD date is the scheduled departure date on the company's booking record for the booking of the service.

## Cutoff by tier

| Tier | Cutoff before the start of the ETD date |
|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 24 hours |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 12 hours |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 48 hours |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 48 hours |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 24 hours |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 24 hours |

## How to find the cutoff

1. Take the ETD date from the booking record.
2. Start from 00:00 on that date, port-of-loading local time.
3. Go back the tier's cutoff hours, each a full 60 minutes. The moment reached is the cutoff.
4. A change received at or before that moment is inside the cutoff; one received after it is not accepted.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical ETD date of 10 July, all times port-of-loading local time)

| Tier | Cutoff | Change received | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 00:00 on 9 July | 8 July at 23:59 | Accepted as to the cutoff |
| AHL Reefer Standard | 00:00 on 9 July | 9 July at 00:00 | Accepted: exactly at the cutoff |
| AHL Reefer Standard | 00:00 on 9 July | 9 July at 00:01 | Not accepted: after the cutoff |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 12:00 on 9 July | 9 July at 12:00 | Accepted: exactly at the cutoff |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 12:00 on 9 July | 9 July at 12:30 | Not accepted |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 00:00 on 8 July | 8 July at 06:00 | Not accepted |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 00:00 on 8 July | 7 July at 18:00 | Accepted as to the cutoff |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

**Wrong reading:** "The cutoff is counted back from the vessel's departure time on the ETD date." **Correct basis:** it is counted back from midnight at the start of the ETD date, whatever the hour of sailing.

**Wrong reading:** "The cutoff is in the time zone of the desk handling the request." **Correct basis:** it is fixed in the local time of the port of loading.

**Wrong reading:** "A change arriving exactly at the cutoff is too late." **Correct basis:** a change received exactly at the cutoff is accepted.
